title: Refactor VAT lookup into a rule table
description:
No behaviour change. Replaces the if/elif chain in `tax_for` with a `TaxRule` table so adding a region is a one-line change (needed for the AT/BE launch next sprint), and exposes `rule_for` for the invoice PDF, which prints the rate.

Tests are now parametrised over every region and also cover rounding and `rule_for`.
